purpose: Isolate economic-core exposure from merely starting later: paired natural vs endowed whole-state starts
shared_recipe: stage_arena.sbatch defaults, 512 games/iteration, 8 actors, fresh Adam; reward, opponents, anchor and action contract unchanged

assessment.mechanism_probe: Broad source-bank held-out source_seed % 5 == 0: first-turn economics, all native actions, no protected-core mask
assessment.natural_evaluation: Full games from turn one on v14hold; no core endowment or state reset
assessment.formal_reserve: 1119000..1119511 remains sealed until selecting a candidate

interpretation: This pair tests the endowment within a shared late-start curriculum. It does not alone identify the effect of late starts vs no curriculum, and short training plus 64 development games cannot establish a breakthrough.
stop_rule: Fixed sample threshold rounded up to complete batches; any engineering quality failure stops. Inspect mechanism and natural-game results before extending. Never train from probe weights.
